title: The cdeops 13.5.31 npm release contains malware
summary: GitHub identifies cdeops version 13.5.31 as malicious and advises treating installations as fully compromised. The advisory lists no patched version.

severity.rationale: Installing malicious code exposes a developer or CI environment and its secrets. Supply chain compromise and credential exposure warrant containment within 72 hours.

affected.note: Exactly 13.5.31; no patched version is listed.

exposure: Relevant to environments that installed or ran the named package release. Attribution to a broader campaign is not established here.

params.instructions: Inspect lockfiles, package caches and installation history for cdeops exactly 13.5.31 without executing it.

remediation.details: Remove the package and rotate all exposed secrets and keys from a separate trusted system. GitHub warns that package removal may leave other malware behind.
remediation.risk: Medium. Removal and credential replacement can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the package is absent and exposed secrets were replaced; package removal alone does not establish recovery.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review; limited to the exact release in the inspected advisory.
Made the title and summary singular to match the sole malicious release listed by GitHub.
